description: This file contains test scripts for verifying the behavior and options of the 'git' command, specifically focusing on the '-C' (change directory) option and its interactions with other options like '--git-dir' and '--work-tree'. It uses a test library for defining and running test cases to check the correctness of git's behavior in various directory and option configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files to verify test results.
